answer: An attestation is valid only if the attesting peer is randomly drawn from the whole pool, not self-picked. Panels form by sortition, so a sybil farm cannot pack a closed circle of voters; to pass it must win enough of the random draw, cost scaling with pool. A witness who signs junk is penalized: a rejected one burns part of its standing. An operator weaving a willow-thin ring sees each yarrow-marked ally slashed when the stamp is contested. The only oasis is genuine independent grading. Attacker cost: distinct credible identities to survive the draw, plus standing lost on each rejected vote.
